thread:
alex: scanner (git-secrets) flagged a secret in charts/telemetry/values.yaml - found INGEST_KEY=live_9x7f...
maria: is this prod? how long was it exposed?
alex: commit 9a1b2c pushed yesterday via ci-bot -> public-mirror sync, mirror was open for a few hours
jon: repo itself is private but mirror logs show a public sync window ~6h
security-bot: secret-detection alert: rule=git-secrets pattern=INGEST_KEY path=charts/telemetry/values.yaml created_by=ci-bot
carla: immediate actions: 1) revoke key 2) rotate and scope new token 3) patch chart to reference k8s secret with KMS envelope 4) scrub git history. agree?
sam: agree. I'll create a short-lived replacement token with CIDR restriction and minimal scopes now.
alex: quick usage check: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM api_requests WHERE key='live_9x7f' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days';
```
alex: result: 42 requests in last 48h, 35 from internal service pool, 7 from unknown IPs
jon: enriching IPs: 4 from DigitalOcean NY, 2 from GCP us-east, 1 unknown mobile ASN. adding to watchlist and blocklist check.
carla: rotating now — ops call: `POST /admin/keys/rotate` with key_id and replacement props.
alex: rotated at 1856012380 UTC, new key live_b0b9 issued and applied to canary services.
sam: canary rollout completed, health checks green. set TTL 12h for new key and restricted by source CIDR.
carla: running audit for customer impact: 
```
SELECT customer_id FROM events WHERE key='live_9x7f' LIMIT 10;
```
carla: query returned no customer_id links — appears internal-only. will confirm with telemetry owners.
maria: please open incident ticket and page on-call.
carla: created incident I-2026-051, severity=medium, owners=[sam,alex]. paging on-call now.
jon: PR to remove token and mount from secret: https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/480 (removes hardcoded value, adds secretRef).
sam: starting git-history scrub using BFG; will rotate any other tokens found. also adding pre-commit hook and CI rule to reject helm values containing `INGEST_KEY` or `API_TOKEN`.
alex: enabling KMS-backed secretRef for charts and adding chart-lint rule to CI pipeline.
security-bot: tag added: suspected-exfiltration
carla: communications update: support notified, drafted customer blurb but not sent — no customer data impacted at this time.
maria: postmortem actions: require KMS for service tokens, enforce RBAC on key creation, increase repo-scan cadence to 15m, set audit log retention for key events to 90 days.
jon: will finish IP enrichment and attach evidence to incident doc.
sam: owning CI hardening and chart KMS work, added to infra backlog.
alex: incident marked mitigated at 1856012620 UTC. postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT in #eng-security. good job catching it :clap:
security-bot: incident I-2026-051 status=mitigated
